---
title: Commodity Receipt Token
description: On-chain warehouse receipts for cocoa, coffee, maize, cotton, and other commodities.
---

## Overview

`CommodityReceiptToken` represents a claim on physical commodity stored in a certified warehouse. Use cases include cooperative receipt financing, cocoa/coffee trade settlement, and cross-border commodity-backed lending.

**Contract:** `CommodityReceiptToken.sol`  
**CLI template:** `commodity`  
**SDK method:** `factory.deployCommodity(opts)`

---

## Metadata Schema

```typescript
interface CommodityMetadata {
  commodityType:        string;  // cocoa | coffee | maize | cotton | soybean | palm-oil
  quantityKg:           bigint;
  gradeClassification:  string;  // e.g. "Grade A", "FAQ", "GC1"
  warehouseId:          string;  // Certified warehouse identifier
  warehouseLocation:    string;  // GPS or address of storage
  depositDate:          bigint;  // Unix timestamp
  expiryDate:           bigint;  // Unix timestamp of receipt expiry
  inspectionReportHash: string;  // bytes32 — IPFS hash of inspection report
  valuationUSD:         bigint;  // 18 decimals
  harvestSeason:        string;  // e.g. "2025/2026"
  lastUpdated:          bigint;
}
```

---

## Deploy

```typescript
const now       = BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
const sixMonths = BigInt(60 * 60 * 24 * 180);

const result = await factory.deployCommodity({
  name:        "Kano Maize Receipt",
  symbol:      "KMR",
  assetId:     "KMR-2025-001",
  countryCode: "NG",
  metadata: {
    commodityType:        "maize",
    quantityKg:           BigInt(5000),
    gradeClassification:  "Grade A",
    warehouseId:          "WH-KANO-001",
    warehouseLocation:    "Dawanau Market, Kano",
    depositDate:          now,
    expiryDate:           now + sixMonths,
    inspectionReportHash: ethers.ZeroHash,
    valuationUSD:         ethers.parseEther("10000"),
    harvestSeason:        "2025/2026",
    lastUpdated:          now,
  },
});
```

---

## Contract-Specific Functions

### Reads

| Function | Returns | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `getMetadata()` | `CommodityMetadata` | Full metadata struct |
| `commodityType()` | `string` | Commodity type string |
| `quantityKg()` | `uint256` | Quantity in kilograms |
| `valuationUSD()` | `uint256` | Current valuation |
| `isExpired()` | `bool` | `block.timestamp > expiryDate` |
| `metadataVersion()` | `uint256` | Metadata update counter |

### Writes (MANAGER\_ROLE)

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `markExpired()` | Sets status to `EXPIRED` and emits `ReceiptExpired` |
| `updateMetadata(CommodityMetadata)` | Full metadata replacement |

---

## Events

```
Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)
MetadataUpdated(uint256 indexed version, uint256 timestamp)
ReceiptExpired(bytes32 indexed assetId, uint256 timestamp)
```
